# Codex Studio 0.1.28
Restores custom themes after the ChatGPT 26.928 update:
- Restores the themed Home composer and removes the dark backdrop behind the chat composer. - Restores the sidebar's translucent glass and rounded corners. - Removes the amber frame around the conversation and softens the glass transition beside the titlebar. - Verifies the visible page correctly when ChatGPT keeps inactive pages mounted.
Includes DreamSkin runtime 1.9.24. Existing themes and workspace preferences are preserved.
